title: Great, powerful portable battery operated fan
text: Great, powerful portable battery operated fan. This is a great rechargeable fan to keep for emergency uses or even to take if you are not anywhere near electricity. I live in Florida and with frequent lightning, I have had several occasions when I was without electricity. When I saw this fan I couldn't wait to try it. It is powerful and holds a charge for a long time. As we enter into hurricane season, this fan will be kept with the rest of my supplies to help if I lose power for a period of time. I also like this for use when we are out on my lanai in the heat to have the fan on helps with circulation and definitely brings the heat levels down. Highly recommend!

product_metadata.title: Geek Aire Rechargeable Fan, Battery Operated High Velocity Floor 16'' Outdoor Fan with 15600mAh Battery, 3-24h Run Time, Power Bank & Waterproof Design for Outdoor, Garage, Barn, Warehouse, Camp … …
features: 【RECHARGEABLE FAN WITH POWER BANK FUNCTION】16" rechargeable fan uses 15600mAh large capacity Lithium-ion battery. It can operate 3-24 hours, which is enough to support one day of cooling. Besides, you can charge your digital devices and camping gear thanks to its power bank function.

【STEPLESS SPEED CONTROL & LED BATTERY INDICATOR】 This battery powered fan has a stepless speed setting, which allows you to control the air flow and noise level by your needs (noise level depend on the speed). There's a 4 gear LED battery life indicator on the control box, which can display battery life clearly, help you ration the battery life however you want and avoid any nasty surprises.

【HIGH VELOCITY FAN WITH 120° ADJUSTMENT】 This battery operated fan possesses an adjustable 120°tilt head, so you can adjust airflow direction by your needed. Besides, unique metal fan blade design combines with powerful brush-less DC motor to provide max 2000 CFM high performance air flow and durable function, it's portable for use in a garage, warehouse, workshop, gym and outdoors.

【IDEAL TOOL FOR OUTDOOR】 This rechargeable electric fan has a IPX4 water-resistant structure which protects it from inclement weather, such as sudden showers when you play outside. Equipped with metal frame and anti-slip rubber feet, this fan has the ability to withstand dropping shocks and to run normally in a wide range of environments. Comes with a carrying handle, makes it easy to transport. Geek Aire 16'' rechargeable fan - a reliable and convenient outdoor cooling solution for you.

【TWO YEAR WARRANTY】2-Year Warranty, plus our friendly customer service. If you have any questions, do not hesitate to contact us. [NOTE: 1.USB cable NOT included 2. This fan can NOT be charged through its USB port 3.To charge the fan using AC power (120-240 VAC, 50-60 Hz), use supplied adapter only.
